name: New Hampshire
agency: New Hampshire State Police, Marine Patrol

rule.textEn: Everyone aged 16 or older who runs a motorboat of more than 25 hp on New Hampshire waters needs a boating education certificate, whatever their birth year.
rule.textEs: Toda persona de 16 años o más que maneje una lancha de más de 25 hp en aguas de Nuevo Hampshire necesita un certificado de educación náutica, sin importar su año de nacimiento.

minAge.note: Certificates are issued from age 16 (a course passed at 15 is certified at 16).

exemptions: Holders of an unexpired USCG commercial license or a New Hampshire commercial boating license.
Holders of a NASBLA-approved certificate from another state, or a U.S. Power Squadron or Coast Guard Auxiliary certificate.

card.feeNote: Online course allowed; adults take the final exam online, under-18s take it in person with a state proctor. In-person retests by a state proctor cost $10; replacements require a written request and the prescribed fee. A one-time 14-day temporary certificate (NH only) is available by test at agent locations.

nonResident: NASBLA-approved certificates from other states are accepted.
rental: A one-time 14-day temporary certificate, valid only in New Hampshire, can be obtained by passing a test (80%) at an agent location from age 16.
